mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan (name, level, price, duration_months, device_count, text_quota, image_quota, video_quota, storage_limit, recommend, status, sort, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{level}, #{price}, #{durationMonths}, #{deviceCount}, #{textQuota}, #{imageQuota}, #{videoQuota}, #{storageLimit}, #{recommend}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
